records.description:
All the records returned by the {@link AwsKinesisStream#records}.
Records obtained here can be directly fed into {@link AwsKinesisStream#putRecord}

nextShardIterator.description: Pointer to the next shard iterator

millisBehindLatest.description:
It is the number of milliseconds the {@link AwsKinesisStream#records} operation's response is from the tip of the stream,
indicating how far behind current time the consumer is. A value of zero indicates record processing is caught up,
and there are no new records to process at this moment.
